key_insight: A Fourier neural operator surrogate learns to correct inexpensive Boussinesq convection simulations toward high-fidelity compressible-flow behavior with a single inference step.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to reduce cost while improving accuracy in natural convection CFD workflows, especially for design studies and parametric sweeps.
method: Train on matched low-cost Boussinesq and high-fidelity compressible simulation pairs.
Use an FNO surrogate implemented and validated in FEniCSx with an implicit monolithic mixed FEM solver.
Evaluate in both 2D and 3D against COMSOL and standard benchmark problems.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports SSIM values close to 1 across flow variables and test distributions, with mean-squared error reduced by roughly one to nearly three orders of magnitude.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of paired training data, and generalization outside the sampled convection regimes may be limited.
paper_title: A Neural Surrogate Approach for Simulating Natural Convection Problems
